files.description: Paths of the files to hand over, absolute or relative to the working directory.

caption.description: One or two sentences on what the files are.

status.description: normal: the user asked for this. proactive: you send it unasked; it also notifies them.

display.description: auto (default): render what can be rendered, offer the rest as downloads. attachment: downloads only. inline: render wherever the type allows it.
